props.title: A millennial party rock band for weddings, birthdays, holiday parties and reunions.
props.lede: Everybody has a song from high school or college that they still know every word to. This is a rock band that plays those songs live, with a lead singer out front, and it’s a perfect choice for a party where most of the guests are in their thirties and forties.

props.title: What does a millennial party band play?
props.lede: Millennial party rock means the big rock and pop songs of the 2000s, from The Killers, Blink-182, Fall Out Boy and Paramore to Kelly Clarkson and Outkast.

props.html: Send us the songs you loved back then, and we’ll put the song list together with you.

rows.text: If you and most of your friends grew up in the 2000s, this band can get your reception dancing to songs everyone knows. We can help with music for the ceremony and the cocktail hour, too.
A 30th or a 40th is a great excuse for a real dance party, whether it’s in your backyard or at a venue you’ve rented.
Plenty of your coworkers likely grew up on these songs, which makes this band a fun pick for a company holiday party.
This band is a great fit for the after-party at a conference or a gala, when people are ready to let loose.

props.html: Planning a longer event? Our acoustic duo is a lovely fit for the cocktail hour, and our DJ can keep the music going between the band’s sets.

props.html: Something else on your mind? Take a look at our planner questions, from how far ahead to book to how loud a band plays.

items.q: How many musicians are in the band?
items.a: The band plays as a four-piece or a five-piece. Tell us about your event and your venue, and we’ll talk through which size fits best.

items.q: How much does a party band cost in Denver?
items.a: We quote each date one by one, since the cost depends on the day, how long you’d like the band to play and where your event is. Our pricing page gives a general view of what live music costs in Denver.

items.q: Can the band play our first dance?
items.a: In most cases, yes. Tell us the song when you book and we’ll check with the band, and we can plan the last song of the night with you, too.

props.title: Planning a party for people who grew up on the 2000s? Send us the date, and we’ll reply with the band’s availability and costs.
props.lede: We’re happy to help with the rest of your event’s music, too.
